lwir_reflective_patch_ranges.description: Passive LWIR range estimation on 8x8 target patches: held-out simulated reflective and ordinary (low-reflectance) targets built from the measured Path 5 Step 1 atmosphere, plus a real IHTest_202104 Path 5 Step 1 check (gate only).
lwir_reflective_patch_ranges.notes: Scored on 288 held-out simulated targets (192 reflective, 96 ordinary; ranges 15-200 m; 96 instrument bands; 1 microflick noise) generated from the paper's radiative-transfer model (Eqs. 7, 23) with the authors' released attenuation and zenith-resolved downwelling spectra. Per-pixel errors are clipped at 100 m and a missing estimate costs 100 m. A run fails (every scored metric set to 100 m) if a submission is malformed (missing/extra-length patches, non-finite or negative ranges), if on either target class it is no better than the best constant range guess, or if its reflective-target error on the real Path 5 Step 1 checkerboards exceeds 60 m. The paper's Table I numbers (real processed cube, three patches) are kept unchanged under _paper_table1; they are not on this gym's scale. The results below are this gym's measured hidden-test values (bispectral is reported as failed by the constant-guess and real-scene gates; its ungated reflective MAE is in scoring/scores_test.json _diagnostics).

reflective_mae_m.description: Mean per-pixel absolute range error (m) over all reflective-target pixels; the paper's central claim (removing reflected-sky range overestimation). Errors clipped at 100 m, a missing estimate counts 100 m.

reflective_patch_abs_error_m.description: Mean over reflective targets of |patch median estimate - true patch range| (m), clipped at 100 m; the patch-level accuracy reported in the paper's Table I (systematic error left after averaging out pixel noise).

ordinary_mae_m.description: Mean per-pixel absolute range error (m) over low-reflectance (ordinary) target pixels; the constraint that correcting reflective targets must not break ordinary scene content. Same clipping and missing-estimate rule.

_paper_table1.note: Paper Table I (quadspectral vs bispectral on the authors' processed Path 5 Step 1 cube, three 8x8 patches, lidar-median ground truth). Errors are |patch mean - ground truth|; std is the within-patch standard deviation. Kept for reference; not on the scored scale.
